name: AGENTS.md
description: Loads AGENTS.md (https://agents.md) into the system prompt: user-global from the resolved agent home (MINIMAL_AGENT_HOME/AGENTS.md), then project from <cwd>/AGENTS.md. On by default. Disable with --no-agents-md, --disable-plugin agents-md, MINIMAL_AGENT_NO_AGENTS_MD=1, or plugins["agents-md"].enabled = false.
